mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN A._SUM > 0 THEN "true" ELSE "false" END FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS _SUM FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_settlement WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND os_state = 1 AND os_amount < 0) AS A

select os_id, shop_name, os_start_date, os_end_date, os_datetime, os_amount, os_order_amount, os_redpacket_amount, os_shipping_amount, os_commis_amount, os_order_return_amount, os_redpacket_return_amount, os_commis_return_amount, os_dealer_commission, os_dealer_return_commission, os_supply_commission, os_supply_return_commission, os_shop_cost_amount, os_state, os_order_type, os_base_member_discount, os_return_member_discount, os_tg_commission, os_fx_commission, os_supper_discount_fee, os_return_supper_discount_fee, os_supply_price, os_return_supply_price, os_return_tg_commission, os_return_fx_commission, self_selling_commission, self_selling_shipping_fee, self_selling_return_cash, self_selling_return_commission, sell_on_amount, sell_on_commission, sell_on_return_cash, sell_on_return_commission FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_settlement where os_id = #{paraMap.osId}

SELECT r.return_code,r.order_id,r.return_cash,r.return_rpt_cash,c.commission_money as return_commision_fee, r.return_state,r.return_add_time,r.buyer_user_account,r.order_id,r.shop_name, oog.goods_id, oog.goods_name, oog.order_goods_payment_amount FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return r left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods oog on oog.order_id = r.order_id left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission c on r.order_id = c.order_id where 1=1
and r.order_live_settlement_id = #{paraMap.orderSettlementId}
and r.return_shop_handle in (0,2,4)
group by r.order_id order by r.return_add_time desc

select sum(ob.order_payment_amount) as orderBasePaymentAmount, sum(ob.base_member_discount) as orderBaseMemberDiscount, sum(ob.order_commission_fee) as orderBaseCommissionFee FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob where ob.shop_id = #{shopId} and ob.combination_type = 1 and ob.drop_shipping = #{dropShipping} and ob.order_is_settlement = '0' AND (ob.order_status IN ('6', '9') or (ob.virtual_goods = 0 and ob.is_cancel = 2)) and ob.order_finished_time >= #{dBefore} and ob.order_finished_time <= now() and ob.payment_code != 3

select sum(tgCommission) as tgCommission,sum(fxCommission) as fxCommission, sum(selfSellingCommission) as selfSellingCommission,sum(selfSellingShippingFee) as selfSellingShippingFee from (
select oc.one_tg_commission+oc.two_tg_commission AS tgCommission, oc.fx_commission AS fxCommission, IFNULL(og.order_goods_commission,0) as selfSellingCommission, IFNULL(og.shipping_fee,0) as selfSellingShippingFee FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og on ob.order_id = og.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission oc on ob.order_id = oc.order_id where ob.shop_id = #{param.shopId} AND (ob.combination_type != 1 OR ob.combination_type is null ) AND og.drop_shipping != 1 AND ob.original_order is null AND ob.payment_code != 3 AND ob.pay_code != 13 AND ob.order_is_settlement ='0' AND ((ob.order_status IN ( '6', '9' ) AND ob.virtual_goods = 1 ) OR (ob.order_status = '9' AND ob.virtual_goods = 1 AND ob.order_refund_status = 2 ) OR (ob.virtual_goods = 0 AND ob.is_cancel = 0 AND ob.order_status IN ( '6' ) ) OR (ob.virtual_goods = 0 AND ob.is_cancel = 2 AND ob.order_status IN ( '9','12' ) ) )
and ob.order_finished_time >= #{param.dBefore} and ob.order_finished_time <= now()
and ob.order_finished_time >= #{param.start} and ob.order_finished_time <= #{param.end}
UNION ALL
select 0 AS tgCommission, 0 AS fxCommission, IFNULL(ob.order_commission_fee,0) as selfSellingCommission, IFNULL(ob.order_shipping_fee,0) as selfSellingShippingFee FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og on ob.order_id = og.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission oc on ob.order_id = oc.order_id where ob.shop_id = #{param.shopId} AND ob.combination_type = 1 AND og.drop_shipping != 1 AND ob.original_order is null AND ob.payment_code != 3 AND ob.pay_code != 13 AND ob.order_is_settlement ='0' AND ((ob.order_status IN ( '6', '9' ) AND ob.virtual_goods = 1 ) OR (ob.order_status = '9' AND ob.virtual_goods = 1 AND ob.order_refund_status = 2 ) OR (ob.virtual_goods = 0 AND ob.is_cancel = 0 AND ob.order_status IN ( '6' ) ) OR (ob.virtual_goods = 0 AND ob.is_cancel = 2 AND ob.order_status IN ( '9','12' ) ) )
and ob.order_finished_time >= #{param.dBefore} and ob.order_finished_time <= now()
and ob.order_finished_time >= #{param.start} and ob.order_finished_time <= #{param.end}
group by ob.order_id ) a

select sum(ob.order_payment_amount) as orderBasePaymentAmount, sum(ob.base_member_discount) as orderBaseMemberDiscount, sum(ob.order_commission_fee) as orderBaseCommissionFee FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob on oor.order_id = ob.order_id where ob.shop_id = #{shopId} and ob.combination_type is not null and ob.combination_type != 0 and ob.order_is_settlement = '0' and ((oor.return_state = 2 and oor.return_method_status in (1, 2)) or (oor.return_state = 4 and oor.return_method_status = 3) or (ob.virtual_goods = 0 and ob.is_cancel = 2)) and ob.order_finished_time >= #{dBefore} and ob.order_finished_time <= now() and ob.payment_code != 3

select ob.order_id as orderId, (ob.order_payment_amount - ob.order_shipping_fee-ob.end_free) as orderPaymentAmount, oog.order_rpt_price as orderRptPrice, oog.shipping_fee as orderShippingFee, sum(oog.order_goods_commission) as orderCommissionFee, ob.order_create_time as orderCreateTime, ob.order_finished_time as orderFinishedTime, ob.buyer_user_id as buyerUserId, ob.buyer_user_name as buyerUserName, ob.base_member_discount as baseMemberDiscount, oc.one_tg_commission + oc.two_tg_commission as tgCommission, oc.fx_commission as fxCommission, ob.combination_type as combinationType, ob.order_payment_amount as orderBasePaymentAmount, ob.base_member_discount as orderBaseMemberDiscount, ob.order_commission_fee as orderBaseCommissionFee, ob.drop_shipping AS dropShipping FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods oog on ob.order_id = oog.order_id AND oog.drop_shipping = 2 LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission oc on ob.order_id = oc.order_id where ob.shop_id = #{param.shopId} and ob.original_order is null and ob.payment_code <> 3 and ob.order_is_settlement = '0' AND (ob.order_status IN ('6', '9') or (ob.virtual_goods = 0 and ob.is_cancel = 2)) and ob.order_finished_time >= #{dBefore} and ob.order_finished_time <= now() group by ob.order_id order by ob.order_finished_time desc

SELECT oor.return_code AS returnCode, oor.order_id AS orderId, oor.return_cash AS returnCash, oor.return_commision_fee AS returnCommisionFee, oor.return_state AS returnState, oor.return_add_time AS returnAddTime, oor.buyer_user_account AS buyerUserAccount, oor.return_rpt_cash AS returnRptCash, oor.return_reason AS returnReason, oor.return_member_discount AS returnMemberDiscount FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob ON oor.order_id = oob.order_id left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods oog on oob.order_id = oog.order_id WHERE oor.shop_id = #{param.shopId} and oob.original_order is null and oor.order_is_settlement = '0' AND oob.order_is_settlement = '0' and ((oor.return_state = 2 and oor.return_method_status in (1, 2)) or (oor.return_state = 4 and oor.return_method_status = 3) or (oob.virtual_goods = 0 and oob.is_cancel = 2)) and oor.return_finish_time >= #{dBefore} and oor.return_finish_time <= now() group by oob.order_id order by oor.return_add_time desc

SELECT a.shop_id, a.shop_name, a.osAmount + IFNULL( roc.notSettlementMoney, 0 ) AS osAmount, a.osOrderReturnAmount, a.osRedpacketAmount, a.osRedpacketReturnAmount, IFNULL( b.withdrawalAmount, 0 ) AS withdrawalAmount, c.undrawnAmount, IFNULL( roc.notSettlementMoney, 0 ) AS notSettlementMoney FROM ( SELECT shop_id, shop_name, sum( os_order_amount ) AS osAmount, sum( os_order_return_amount ) AS osOrderReturnAmount, sum( os_redpacket_amount ) AS osRedpacketAmount, sum( os_redpacket_return_amount ) AS osRedpacketReturnAmount FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_settlement WHERE os_datetime BETWEEN #{param.startTime} and #{param.endTime} GROUP BY shop_id ) a left join (select shop_id,sum(os_amount) as withdrawalAmount FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_settlement where os_state = 5 and os_datetime BETWEEN #{param.startTime} and #{param.endTime} GROUP BY shop_id ) b on a.shop_id = b.shop_id left join (select shop_id,sum(os_amount) as undrawnAmount FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_settlement where os_state in (1,4) and os_datetime BETWEEN #{param.startTime} and #{param.endTime} GROUP BY shop_id ) c on a.shop_id = c.shop_id left join (SELECT oa.orderAmount - IFNULL(ro.returnAmount,0) as notSettlementMoney,oa.shop_id FROM (SELECT ( sum( order_payment_amount ) + sum( order_rpt_price )) AS orderAmount, shop_id,shop_name FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base WHERE order_is_settlement = '0' and order_status BETWEEN 2 and 6 and payment_time BETWEEN #{param.startTime} AND #{param.endTime} GROUP BY shop_id ) oa LEFT JOIN (SELECT( sum( return_cash ) + sum( return_rpt_cash ) ) AS returnAmount,shop_id,shop_name FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return WHERE order_is_settlement = '0' AND return_state = '4' AND return_add_time BETWEEN #{param.startTime} AND #{param.endTime} GROUP BY shop_id ) ro on oa.shop_id = ro.shop_id) roc on a.shop_id = roc.shop_id
a.shop_name like CONCAT('%',#{param.shopName},'%')

SELECT oor.return_code AS returnCode, oor.order_id AS orderId, oog.goods_id, oog.goods_name, oog.order_goods_payment_amount, oor.return_cash AS returnCash, oor.return_commision_fee AS returnCommisionFee, oor.return_state AS returnState, oor.return_add_time AS returnAddTime, oor.buyer_user_account AS buyerUserAccount, oor.return_rpt_cash AS returnRptCash, oor.return_reason AS returnReason, oor.return_member_discount AS returnMemberDiscount, if(oor.return_method_status = 1, sob.order_refund_price, sob.order_return_price) AS supperReturnPrice FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob ON oor.order_id = oob.order_id left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods oog on oob.order_id = oog.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_supplier_base sob on sob.order_id = oob.order_id WHERE oor.shop_id = #{shopId} and sob.supplier_shop_id != #{shopId} and oor.order_is_settlement = '0' and ((oor.return_state = 2 and oor.return_method_status in (1, 2)) or (oor.return_state = 4 and oor.return_method_status = 3) or (oob.virtual_goods = 0 and oob.is_cancel = 2)) AND oog.drop_shipping = 1 and (oog.goods_return_status = 2 or oog.goods_refund_status = 2) AND oor.return_finish_time >= #{dBefore} and oor.return_finish_time <= now() group by oob.order_id order by oor.return_add_time desc

SELECT ob.order_id AS orderId, oog.goods_id, oog.goods_name, oog.order_goods_payment_amount, (ob.order_payment_amount - ob.order_shipping_fee) AS orderPaymentAmount, ob.order_rpt_price AS orderRptPrice, oog.shipping_fee AS orderShippingFee, oog.order_goods_commission AS orderCommissionFee, ob.order_create_time AS orderCreateTime, ob.order_finished_time AS orderFinishedTime, ob.buyer_user_id AS buyerUserId, ob.buyer_user_name AS buyerUserName, oog.goods_member_discount AS baseMemberDiscount, oc.one_tg_commission + two_tg_commission AS tgCommission, oc.fx_commission AS fxCommission, sob.goods_price_sum AS supperPriceSum FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods oog on ob.order_id = oog.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission oc ON ob.order_id = oc.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_supplier_base sob on sob.order_id = ob.order_id and oog.deliver_shop_id = sob.supplier_shop_id WHERE ob.shop_id = #{param.shopId} and oog.deliver_shop_id != #{param.shopId} and oog.drop_shipping = 1 and ob.order_is_settlement = '0' AND (ob.order_status IN ('6', '9') or (ob.virtual_goods = 0 and ob.is_cancel = 2)) AND ob.order_finished_time >= #{dBefore} AND ob.order_finished_time <= now() and ob.payment_code != 3 group by ob.order_id,oog.goods_id ORDER BY ob.order_finished_time DESC

SELECT sum(ob.order_shipping_fee) AS orderShippingFee, sum(oog.order_goods_payment_amount) AS orderPaymentAmount, sum(sob.goods_price) AS orderSupplyAmount, sum(oog.order_goods_amount) AS orderGoodsAmount, sum(ob.order_rpt_price) AS orderRptPrice, sum(oog.voucher_price) AS orderVoucherPrice, sum(oog.order_goods_commission) AS orderCommissionFee, sum(ob.dealer_commission) AS dealerCommission, sum(ob.dealer_return_commission) AS dealerReturnCommission, sum(ob.supply_commission) AS supplyCommission, sum(ob.supply_return_commission) AS supplyReturnCommission, sum(oog.goods_member_discount) AS baseMemberDiscount, sum(oc.one_tg_commission + oc.two_tg_commission) AS tgCommission, sum(oc.fx_commission) AS fxCommission, sum(sob.goods_price_sum) as supperPriceSum FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods oog on ob.order_id = oog.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission oc ON ob.order_id = oc.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_supplier_base sob on sob.order_id = ob.order_id and oog.deliver_shop_id = sob.supplier_shop_id WHERE ob.shop_id = #{shopId} and oog.deliver_shop_id != #{shopId} and oog.drop_shipping = 1 and ob.order_is_settlement = '0' AND (ob.order_status IN ('6', '9') or (ob.virtual_goods = 0 and ob.is_cancel = 2)) AND ob.order_finished_time >= #{dBefore} AND ob.order_finished_time <= now() AND ob.payment_code != 3

SELECT sum(oor.return_rpt_cash) AS returnRptCash, sum(oor.return_cash) AS returnCash, sum(oor.return_commision_fee) AS orderReturnCommissionFee, sum(oor.return_member_discount) AS returnMemberDiscount, sum(oor.return_rpt_cash) AS returnRptCash, sum(if(oor.return_cash = oog.order_goods_payment_amount,oog.voucher_price,0)) AS returnVoucherPrice, sum(if(oor.return_method_status = 1, sob.order_refund_price, sob.order_return_price)) AS supperReturnPrice FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob ON oor.order_id = oob.order_id left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods oog on oob.order_id = oog.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_supplier_base sob on sob.order_id = oob.order_id and oog.deliver_shop_id = sob.supplier_shop_id WHERE oor.shop_id = #{shopId} and oog.deliver_shop_id != #{shopId} and oor.order_is_settlement = '0' and ((oor.return_state = 2 and oor.return_method_status in (1, 2)) or (oor.return_state = 4 and oor.return_method_status = 3) or (oob.virtual_goods = 0 and oob.is_cancel = 2)) AND oog.drop_shipping = 1 AND oor.return_finish_time >= #{dBefore} and oor.return_finish_time <= now()

SELECT oor.return_code AS returnCode, oor.order_id AS orderId, if(oog.drop_shipping = 1, if(oor.return_method_status = 1, sob.order_refund_price, sob.order_return_price), oor.return_cash) AS returnCash, if(oog.drop_shipping = 1, sob.supper_return_commission, oor.return_commision_fee) AS returnCommisionFee, oor.return_state AS returnState, oor.return_add_time AS returnAddTime, oor.buyer_user_account AS buyerUserAccount, oor.return_rpt_cash AS returnRptCash, oor.return_reason AS returnReason, oor.return_member_discount AS returnMemberDiscount, oor.return_supper_discount_fee AS returnSupperDiscountFee, oog.goods_id, oog.goods_name, oog.order_goods_payment_amount FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob ON oor.order_id = oob.order_id left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods oog on oob.order_id = oog.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_supplier_base sob on sob.order_id = oor.order_id and oog.deliver_shop_id = sob.supplier_shop_id WHERE oog.deliver_shop_id = #{shopId} and oor.order_supply_is_settlement = '0' and ((oor.return_state = 2 and oor.return_method_status in (1, 2)) or (oor.return_state = 4 and oor.return_method_status = 3) or (oob.virtual_goods = 0 and oob.is_cancel = 2)) AND oor.return_finish_time >= #{dBefore} and oor.return_finish_time <= now() group by oob.order_id,oog.goods_id order by returnAddTime desc

SELECT ob.order_id AS orderId, (if(oog.drop_shipping = 1, sob.goods_payment_amount - oog.shipping_fee, oog.order_goods_payment_amount)) AS orderPaymentAmount, oog.shipping_fee AS orderShippingFee, (if(oog.drop_shipping = 1, sob.supper_commission, oog.shipping_fee)) AS orderCommissionFee, ob.order_create_time AS orderCreateTime, ob.order_finished_time AS orderFinishedTime, ob.buyer_user_id AS buyerUserId, ob.buyer_user_name AS buyerUserName, oog.goods_member_discount AS baseMemberDiscount, ob.distribution_discount AS supperDiscountFee, oog.goods_id, oog.goods_name, oog.order_goods_payment_amount FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods oog on oog.order_id = ob.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission oc ON ob.order_id = oc.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_supplier_base sob on sob.order_id = ob.order_id and oog.deliver_shop_id = sob.supplier_shop_id WHERE oog.deliver_shop_id = #{shopId} and ob.order_supply_is_settlement = '0' AND ob.order_status IN ('6', '9') AND ob.order_finished_time >= #{dBefore} AND ob.order_finished_time <= now() group by ob.order_id,oog.goods_id ORDER BY ob.order_finished_time DESC

SELECT sum(ob.order_shipping_fee) AS orderShippingFee, sum(if(oog.drop_shipping = 1, sob.goods_payment_amount, oog.order_goods_payment_amount)) AS orderPaymentAmount, sum(oog.order_goods_amount) AS orderGoodsAmount, sum(oog.order_rpt_price) AS orderRptPrice, sum(if(oog.drop_shipping = 1, sob.supper_commission, oog.order_goods_commission)) AS orderCommissionFee, sum(ob.distribution_discount) AS supperDiscountFee, sum(oog.goods_member_discount) as baseMemberDiscount FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods oog on oog.order_id = ob.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission oc ON ob.order_id = oc.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_supplier_base sob on sob.order_id = ob.order_id and oog.deliver_shop_id = sob.supplier_shop_id WHERE oog.deliver_shop_id = #{shopId} AND ob.order_supply_is_settlement = '0' AND ob.order_status IN ('6', '9') AND ob.order_finished_time >= #{dBefore} AND ob.order_finished_time <= now()

SELECT sum(oor.return_rpt_cash) AS returnRptCash, sum(if(oog.drop_shipping = 1, if(oor.return_method_status = 1, sob.order_refund_price, sob.order_return_price), oor.return_cash)) AS returnCash, sum(if(oog.drop_shipping = 1, sob.supper_return_commission, oor.return_commision_fee)) AS orderReturnCommissionFee, sum(oor.return_member_discount) AS returnMemberDiscount, sum(oor.return_supper_discount_fee) AS returnSupperDiscountFee FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_return oor LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base oob ON oor.order_id = oob.order_id left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods oog on oog.order_id = oob.order_id LEFT join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_supplier_base sob on sob.order_id = oor.order_id and oog.deliver_shop_id = sob.supplier_shop_id WHERE (oob.shop_id = #{shopId} or oog.deliver_shop_id = #{shopId}) AND oor.order_supply_is_settlement = '0' and ((oor.return_state = 2 and oor.return_method_status in (1, 2)) or (oor.return_state = 4 and oor.return_method_status = 3) or (oob.virtual_goods = 0 and oob.is_cancel = 2)) AND oor.return_finish_time >= #{dBefore} AND oor.return_finish_time <= now()
select sum(pay_total_amount) from ${database.prefix.webpos}hou_wps_order where shop_id = #{shopId} and order_status = 1
select sum(pay_total_amount) from ${database.prefix.webpos}hou_wps_order where shop_id = #{shopId} and order_status = 3
